allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Tells the life story of Danish author Karen Blixen, who at the beginning of the 20th century moved to Africa to build a new life for herself. The film is based on her 1937 autobiographical novel.

facts.title: Out of Africa

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Can a Danish writer leave her past behind to forge an enduring future in an unfamiliar world?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: At the start of the twentieth century, Danish author Karen Blixen journeys to Africa to establish a new life, navigating sweeping romance and unfamiliar terrain in Sydney Pollack's historical drama.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A slow, emotionally heavy historical romance demanding engaged focus across an expansive 161-minute runtime.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Director Sydney Pollack delivers an expansive, deeply felt historical romance that rewards patient viewing with reflective storytelling and richly textured drama.
